source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: curl -s -k -u "$BMC_USER:$BMC_PASS" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -X GET https://$BMC_IP/redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory | jq .FirmwareInventory[] | select(.Name|test("SMC";"i") or test("FPGA";"i"))
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL pretty-printed JSON from /redfish/v1/UpdateService/FirmwareInventory (SMC_FPGA firmware entry) so user can read/diff against SPEC for "SMC_FPGA". No RISK (read-only).

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes an inline FirmwareInventory array and OR-matches any SMC or FPGA name, so unrelated components can be returned; TLS, pagination and lifecycle semantics are absent.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires exact SMC_FPGA topology/ID, complete active-staged lifecycle fields and a no-update boundary.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 965/2291 accepts the substring command under a generic gate.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: UBB is chassis/component inventory and generic FPGA records may be different targets; neither can replace exact SMC_FPGA identity.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-33 retains WebUI evidence; ED-34 permits approved inventory tools; ED-35 prevents version-only/substring coverage; ED-36 treats mapping/reference as readiness; ED-44 preserves exact firmware target identity.

original_test_intent: Verify the SMC_FPGA information displayed by the BMC is readable and correct for the exact platform component.
original_method: Enumerate complete firmware inventory, resolve the SMC FPGA by approved topology and immutable component ID, collect protected read-only identity/version/status/active-staged lifecycle evidence, and compare it with WebUI and the Project firmware matrix without invoking UpdateService.
manual_activity: The owner identifies the exact SMC FPGA and approves its lifecycle/version reference. The agent may collect protected inventory only; component ambiguity and final acceptance remain engineer-owned.
required_inputs: SMC FPGA topology and immutable component ID
safety_requirements: Do not upload firmware, invoke update/rollback, reset or reboot.
Do not select targets by SMC-or-FPGA substring alone.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Redact hashes and security-sensitive inventory metadata.
Stop on duplicate/ambiguous component or unknown lifecycle state without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Map the exact SMC FPGA through vendor topology and stable ID.
Collect complete redacted version, state, health, active/staged and updateability fields.
Correlate with WebUI and approved firmware matrix.
Return evidence only and prove no UpdateService action occurred.
engineer_actions: Approve exact SMC FPGA identity and topology.
Approve lifecycle semantics and expected version.
Review mismatches and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Unsafe as acceptance evidence: OR substring matching is not component identity, and collection shape, pagination, lifecycle fields and TLS trust are unverified.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate the actual FirmwareInventory collection and bind the target by approved immutable ID/topology before comparing complete read-only lifecycle data.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: SMC_FPGA, WebUI inspection, Criterion and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use exact-target, complete protected firmware-inventory reconciliation under a strict no-update/no-reset boundary.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected system management-controller FPGA component.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, UpdateService schema and inventory parser versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor SMC FPGA topology/lifecycle definition and Project firmware matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable target resolution, complete lifecycle evidence and explicit separation from firmware update while retaining WebUI validation.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A name substring or version alone cannot prove the correct SMC FPGA, active image, staged image, health or updateability.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Exact target map, lifecycle semantics and approved version baseline.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong-target matches can look plausible; any accidental UpdateService action may impair management availability.

project_override_considerations: Alternate inventory collectors require exact SMC FPGA target binding, equivalent lifecycle fields, engineer approval and disclosure of uncovered WebUI/Redfish coverage; they do not authorize flashing.
expected_evidence: Exact SMC FPGA topology and stable ID
Complete paginated raw redacted inventory record

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently requests SMC_FPGA inventory correctness; DeepSeek's broad substring is an inadequate implementation, not a different target authorization.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read-only SMC_FPGA inventory purpose is clear; exact component and expected lifecycle values are Project execution-readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Replaces ambiguous substring selection with exact target and complete lifecycle evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and no-update boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Adds exact identity, pagination and lifecycle gates missing from generic direct execution.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Prevents UBB or unrelated FPGA entries from satisfying SMC_FPGA coverage.

review_improvement: Eliminates wrong-target false positives and distinguishes read-only firmware inventory from firmware update validation.
independent_technical_reasoning: FirmwareInventory commonly contains multiple controllers and programmable devices whose names overlap. Acceptance needs immutable topology-backed identity and lifecycle context because the displayed version may be staged rather than active; inventory reading must never be allowed to trigger an update action.
